Miscellaneous.description: The current altitude of the cabin pressurization..

Miscellaneous.name: PRESSURIZATION_CABIN_ALTITUDE_GOAL
Miscellaneous.description: The set altitude of the cabin pressurization.

Miscellaneous.name: PRESSURIZATION_CABIN_ALTITUDE_RATE
Miscellaneous.description: The rate at which cabin pressurization changes.

Miscellaneous.name: PRESSURIZATION_PRESSURE_DIFFERENTIAL
Miscellaneous.description: The difference in pressure between the set altitude pressurization and the current pressurization.

Miscellaneous.name: PRESSURIZATION_DUMP_SWITCH
Miscellaneous.description: True if the cabin pressurization dump switch is on.

Miscellaneous.name: FIRE_BOTTLE_SWITCH
Miscellaneous.description: True if the fire bottle switch is on.

Miscellaneous.name: FIRE_BOTTLE_DISCHARGED
Miscellaneous.description: True if the fire bottle is discharged.

Miscellaneous.name: CABIN_NO_SMOKING_ALERT_SWITCH
Miscellaneous.description: True if the No Smoking switch is on.

Miscellaneous.name: CABIN_SEATBELTS_ALERT_SWITCH
Miscellaneous.description: True if the Seatbelts switch is on.

Miscellaneous.name: GPWS_WARNING
Miscellaneous.description: True if Ground Proximity Warning System installed.

Miscellaneous.name: GPWS_SYSTEM_ACTIVE
Miscellaneous.description: True if the Ground Proximity Warning System is active

Miscellaneous.name: CRASH_FLAG
Miscellaneous.description: One of:; 0: None; 2: Mountain; 4: General; 6: Building; 8: Splash; 10: Gear up; 12: Overstress; 14: Building; 16: Aircraft; 18: Fuel Truck

Miscellaneous.name: IS_ALTITUDE_FREEZE_ON
Miscellaneous.description: True if the altitude of the aircraft is frozen.

Miscellaneous.name: IS_ATTITUDE_FREEZE_ON
Miscellaneous.description: True if the attitude (pitch, bank and heading) of the aircraft is frozen.

AI Controlled Aircraft.name: AI_DESIRED_SPEED
AI Controlled Aircraft.description: Desired speed of the AI object.

AI Controlled Aircraft.name: AI_WAYPOINT_LIST
AI Controlled Aircraft.description: List of waypoints that an AI controlled object should follow.

AI Controlled Aircraft.name: AI_DESIRED_HEADING
AI Controlled Aircraft.description: Desired heading of the AI object.

AI Controlled Aircraft.name: AI_GROUNDTURNTIME
AI Controlled Aircraft.description: Time to make a 90 degree turn.

AI Controlled Aircraft.name: AI_TRAFFIC_ISIFR
AI Controlled Aircraft.description: Request whether this aircraft is IFR or VFR See Note 1.

AI Controlled Aircraft.name: AI_TRAFFIC_CURRENT_AIRPORT
AI Controlled Aircraft.description: ICAO code of current airport. See Note 1.

AI Controlled Aircraft.name: AI_TRAFFIC_FROMAIRPORT
AI Controlled Aircraft.description: ICAO code of the departure airport in the current schedule. See Note 2.

AI Controlled Aircraft.name: AI_TRAFFIC_TOAIRPORT
AI Controlled Aircraft.description: ICAO code of the destination airport in the current schedule. See Note 2.

AI Controlled Aircraft.name: AI_TRAFFIC_ETD
AI Controlled Aircraft.description: Estimated time of departure for the current schedule entry, given as the number of seconds difference from the current simulation time. This can be negative if ETD is earlier than the current simulation time. See Note 2.

AI Controlled Aircraft.name: AI_TRAFFIC_ETA
AI Controlled Aircraft.description: Estimated time of arrival for the current schedule entry, given as the number of seconds difference from the current simulated time. This can be negative if ETA is earlier than the current simulated time. See Note 2.

Carrier Operations.name: LAUNCHBAR_POSITION
Carrier Operations.description: Installed on aircraft before takeoff from a carrier catapult. Note that gear cannot retract with this extended. 100 = fully extended. Refer to the document Notes on Aircraft Systems.

Carrier Operations.name: LAUNCHBAR_SWITCH
Carrier Operations.description: If this is set to True the launch bar switch has been engaged.

Carrier Operations.name: LAUNCHBAR_HELD_EXTENDED
Carrier Operations.description: This will be True if the launchbar is fully extended, and can be used, for example, to change the color of an instrument light.

Carrier Operations.name: NUMBER_OF_CATAPULTS
Carrier Operations.description: Maximum of 4. A model can contain more than 4 catapults, but only the first four will be read and recognized by the simulation.

Carrier Operations.name: CATAPULT_STROKE_POSITION:index
Carrier Operations.description: Catapults are indexed from 1. This value will be 0 before the catapult fires, and then up to 100 as the aircraft is propelled down the catapult. The aircraft may takeoff before the value reaches 100 (depending on the aircraft weight, power applied, and other factors), in which case this value will not be further updated. This value could be used to drive a bogie animation.

Carrier Operations.name: HOLDBACK_BAR_INSTALLED
Carrier Operations.description: Holdback bars allow build up of thrust before takeoff from a catapult, and are installed by the deck crew of an aircraft carrier.

Carrier Operations.name: BLAST_SHIELD_POSITION:index
Carrier Operations.description: Indexed from 1, 100 is fully deployed, 0 flat on deck

Carrier Operations.name: CABLE_CAUGHT_BY_TAILHOOK
Carrier Operations.description: A number 1 through 4 for the cable number caught by the tailhook. Cable 1 is the one closest to the stern of the carrier. A value of 0 indicates no cable was caught.

Carrier Operations.name: TAILHOOK_HANDLE
Carrier Operations.description: True if the tailhook handle is engaged.

Carrier Operations.name: SURFACE_RELATIVE_GROUND_SPEED
Carrier Operations.description: The speed of the aircraft relative to the speed of the first surface directly underneath it. Use this to retrieve, for example, an aircraft's taxiing speed while it is moving on a moving carrier. It also applies to airborne aircraft, for example when a helicopter is successfully hovering above a moving ship, this value should be zero. The returned value will be the same as GROUND VELOCITY if the first surface beneath it is not moving.

Racing.name: RECIP_ENG_DETONATING:index
Racing.description: Indexed from 1. Set to True if the engine is detonating.

Racing.name: RECIP_ENG_CYLINDER_HEALTH:index
Racing.description: Index high 16 bits is engine number, low 16 cylinder number, both indexed from 1.

Racing.name: RECIP_ENG_NUM_CYLINDERS
Racing.description: Indexed from 1. The number of engine cylinders.

Racing.name: RECIP_ENG_NUM_CYLINDERS_FAILED
Racing.description: Indexed from 1. The number of cylinders that have failed.

Racing.name: RECIP_ENG_ANTIDETONATION_TANK_VALVE:index
Racing.description: Indexed from 1, each engine can have one antidetonation tank. Installed on racing aircraft. Refer to the document Notes on Aircraft Systems.

Racing.name: RECIP_ENG_ANTIDETONATION_TANK_QUANTITY:index
Racing.description: Indexed from 1. Refer to the Mission Creation documentationfor the procedure for refilling tanks.

Racing.name: RECIP_ENG_ANTIDETONATION_TANK_MAX_QUANTITY:index
Racing.description: Indexed from 1. This value set in the Aircraft Configuration File.

Racing.name: RECIP_ENG_NITROUS_TANK_VALVE:index
Racing.description: Indexed from 1. Each engine can have one Nitrous fuel tank installed.

Racing.name: RECIP_ENG_NITROUS_TANK_QUANTITY:index
Racing.description: Indexed from 1. Refer to the Mission Creation documentationfor the procedure for refilling tanks.

Racing.name: RECIP_ENG_NITROUS_TANK_MAX_QUANTITY:index
Racing.description: Indexed from 1. This value set in the Aircraft Configuration File.
